25.name: Chimney Soot
25.why: The black above the hearth, where the bread stays warm all night.

25.name: Cold Hearth
25.why: What the fire leaves at dawn, still warm to the hand.

25.name: Oilcloth Night
25.why: The black oilcloth my pictures sit on, under every feast I painted.

26.name: Bread Crust
26.why: The golden top of the bread my mother pulls from the tonir.

26.name: Sunbaked Loaf
26.why: A flatbread left on the feast table at noon, baked by the sun and by love.

26.name: Tonir Wall
26.why: The clay oven's side in our courtyard, colored by a hundred baking days.
